features.title: One view for reachable nearby loot
features.recommendation: Keep the admitted-root nearby projection. Quartermaster can inspect multiple storage targets, but that is not a replacement loot pane.

features.title: Safe bulk transfer between selected containers
features.recommendation: Essentials retains its reference/transaction service. Quartermaster already owns a separate logistics executor. A general explicit preview remains unfinished; do not merge executors or introduce a dependency without a reviewed contract.

features.title: Put loot into designated or seeded storage
features.recommendation: Quartermaster already supplies designated category/item rules, priorities and sorting. Keep current Essentials seeded sorting for standalone use; do not rebuild designation policy. Prevent competing menu actions/plans when both are enabled.

features.title: Keep inventory selection through refreshes
features.recommendation: Keep native inventory selection repair here. The UI library has focus helpers, not this inventory integration.

features.title: Protect favorites and reserved equipment from bulk actions
features.recommendation: Both executors already check some protected states. Quartermaster SupplyAPI checks favorites, equipped/attached and crafting-consumed items. Define interoperability for active reservations; no portfolio-wide protection API is established.

features.title: Make context actions easier to find
features.recommendation: Keep native context grouping here. Domain callbacks and validation remain with their owning mods; UI may supply reusable controls.

features.title: Inspect nested bags without unpacking
features.recommendation: Essentials has traversal and nested stable references, while Quartermaster has selected nested-bag logistics. Neither establishes the proposed finished nested browser. Keep the read model in Essentials; UI may render controls.

features.title: Choose an exact whole-item transfer count
features.recommendation: Exact whole-item count selection belongs with inventory workflows. Quartermaster shopping target quantities are not the same native inventory transfer dialog.

features.title: Separate equipped items from carried clutter
features.recommendation: The Equipped view is already in Essentials. UI can provide presentation helpers; SPXTRM owns light attachments only and must not own this inventory pane.

features.title: Show read watched and useful-media progress
features.recommendation: Keep existing menu progress and carried-duplicate hints in Essentials. Knowledge & Wisdom already supplies bounded recorded-media inspection and owns custom knowledge/research. Do not create a second knowledge ledger; any optional adapter remains unimplemented.

features.title: Compare fill across container buttons and magazine entries
features.recommendation: Simultaneous container-button and magazine fill cues fit planned vanilla presentation adapters. UI has reusable controls but no implemented overlay. Essentials can supply permitted inventory views.

features.title: Compact local injury summary outside the health panel
features.recommendation: Health Care has examination reports and an examiner/patient-scoped five-minute snapshot, not a live injury HUD. Put medical visibility/meaning there and rendering in UI. Medical Checks supplies no enforcing consent service today.

features.title: Load and unload matching magazines in batches
features.recommendation: Keep existing matching-magazine native action orchestration. Power and SPXTRM do not own firearm ammunition.

features.title: Configurable non-equipment item and recipe action slots
features.recommendation: Essentials owns ordinary item/recipe invocation and validation; UI can render/configure slots. PC Framework apps are world-computer applications, not global survivor action shortcuts.

features.title: Customize local world-container button presets and order
features.recommendation: Local button label/icon/order presets belong to UI presentation. Quartermaster storage presets/rules and Rooms room names already exist but are different data. Displaying a label must not create a designation or edit shared names.

features.title: Choose a safe destination for bulky crafting output
features.recommendation: Keep existing native craft-output routing. Junk Drawer owns salvage outcomes and Provisions owns food-process outcomes; do not intercept or redirect their custom transactions without an explicit provider contract.

features.title: Arrange hotbar slots without reattaching items
features.recommendation: Keep current slot reordering and saved attachment-index handling. Shared styling can use UI.

features.title: Show condition directly on hotbar slots
features.recommendation: Hotbar-only condition display is a planned vanilla UI adapter. Eyewear already displays its own retainer durability, which does not cover general hotbar condition.

features.title: Preserve a configured default map-symbol scale
features.recommendation: Keep the current default-symbol-scale behavior. Rooms designation editing and SPXTRM optical rendering are different systems.

features.title: Keep device power actions attached to the device
features.recommendation: Keep grouping in Essentials and battery transactions in Power; light-specific servicing belongs to SPXTRM. Essentials still probes legacy powerWorks globals/imports, while renamed Power has no legacy aliases: current pairing requires a compatibility repair and tests.

features.title: Plan a finite vehicle-part service itinerary
features.recommendation: No general vehicle-service owner was identified. A finite vanilla vehicle-part itinerary fits Essentials. CAT construction machinery qualification and Eyewear retainers do not cover ordinary mechanics. Scope excludes clothing queues.

features.title: Queue a chosen eligible unread-book and media playlist
features.recommendation: Essentials may orchestrate native reading; Knowledge & Wisdom owns provider documents, completion and knowledge requirements. A finished reading/media playlist was not found. Preserve its MP authority guard; start only with a proven native reading slice.

features.title: File keys into an eligible carried key ring
features.recommendation: Keep current key/ring predicates and native transfers. Quartermaster storage/shopping rules are not a key-ring replacement.

features.title: Preview and queue cleanup across a chosen rectangle
features.recommendation: Already covered by Auto Clean rectangle/paint/erase/floor selection, confirmation, building cleanup, guarded actions and tool returns. Remove duplicate implementation work from Essentials. Validate or improve the existing Auto Clean workflow in its own repository.

features.title: Estimate remaining generator runtime from inspected load
features.recommendation: Power already reports loaded generator fuel, condition, activation, connection and native consumption. A remaining-runtime estimate is not implemented in that adapter; keep calculation/units with Power and optional presentation with UI. Electrical output capacity remains unknown.

features.title: Make partial transfer failures understandable
features.recommendation: Essentials exposes committed result snapshots; Quartermaster has progress, rejection and partial-outcome presentation. Reuse each executor result contract. A common result vocabulary may be specified, but is not currently a shared implemented API.

features.title: Replace an eligible bandage with one request
features.recommendation: One-request replace-bandage sequencing belongs to medical procedure ownership, with native action guards. Medical Checks is a blocked consent scaffold, not a treatment engine.

features.title: Compare revealed care needs across animals in one table
features.recommendation: No general livestock owner was identified among these projects. Dog Training is canine-specific and not a deployed herd-care provider. Keep a neutral read-only proposal; do not silently expand Dog Training or Harvest scope.

features.title: Mark not-yet-readable media for later without granting knowledge
features.recommendation: Local seen-for-later media notes fit Essentials. Quartermaster Dibs personal item labels/Wanted/Needed lists overlap in intent, but do not prove an unreadability-aware media bookmark. Integrate optionally rather than duplicate shopping or knowledge ledgers.

features.title: Independent-hand compatibility classifier foundation
features.recommendation: Keep only current independent-hand classifier foundation. It supplies no off-hand attacks, animations or finished swapping workflow. Eyewear protection and SPXTRM light mounts have separate ownership.

features.title: Restore magazines to their source after native loading
features.recommendation: The retained delta is magazine source restoration only. Auto Clean already returns its borrowed cleaning equipment through its own job/SupplyAPI contract; generic crafting returns are vanilla and stay excluded.

features.title: Compare per-item and stack weights in a dedicated column
features.recommendation: Optional simultaneous per-item/stack weight columns fit vanilla UI adapters. Quartermaster carry budgets govern logistics, not a general native inventory column.

features.title: Display available watch time more precisely
features.recommendation: Essentials owns exact-minute formatting; Power owns powered watches, cell charge and mechanical/digital device distinctions. Current legacy namespace integration needs review; neither project should invent hidden watch information.

features.title: Plan treatment over already revealed eligible wounds
features.recommendation: Finite treatment plans belong to Health Care. Its reservation/procedure framework is related foundation, not a finished wound itinerary. Do not use inactive Medical Checks preferences as valid consent.

features.title: Optional fridge and freezer off control
features.recommendation: Power infrastructure/appliance registries are related foundation. No implemented fridge/freezer off toggle is established by the reviewed adapter/API/docs. Provisions can consume real appliance state; it should not own a competing electrical simulation.

features.title: Mark only player-observed locations automatically
features.recommendation: Observed-only native map annotation fits Essentials. Knowledge & Wisdom geographic familiarity and Rooms designations are separate facts and must not reveal unobserved world state. UI may style controls.

features.title: Queue a chosen multi-window curtain or barricade itinerary
features.recommendation: Essentials may orchestrate player-selected vanilla curtain/barricade actions. Rooms can supply explicit permitted geometry only through a reviewed adapter; its existing API explicitly does not enforce unrelated doors/building/destruction actions. Fences & Gates owns its added construction content.

features.title: Plan selected-area corpse handling to one destination
features.recommendation: Selected-area corpse handling is an Auto Clean extension candidate, not current trash cleanup. Corpses must use native handling and exact identities; Health Care recovers body parts and MORTIS supplies anatomy/provenance, neither is a hauling planner.

features.title: Queue native firearm and magazine unloading in one request
features.recommendation: A finite native firearm/magazine unloading sequence belongs with existing magazine workflows. Do not introduce instant extraction or modify ammunition counts directly.

features.title: Queue work over player-selected eligible plots
features.recommendation: Harvest owns crops, bounded field inspection and crop-side irrigation. A selected-plot planting/watering/harvest itinerary is not implemented. Waterworks owns real water withdrawal/quality; atomic cross-owner delivery remains incomplete.

features.title: Heavy-object provider lifecycle foundation
features.recommendation: Keep generic capability/lifecycle foundation in Essentials. Quartermaster already owns carry logistics; Earthworks/CAT own terrain/machine/wheelbarrow state. No generic physics provider is established and the experimental Earthworks wheelbarrow is SP-only.

features.title: Queue native care over a player-selected herd list
features.recommendation: No general herd-care owner was identified. Dog Training owns canine-specific tasks and remains blocked on native ownership/persistence. Do not create client-authoritative animal jobs or treat crop irrigation as animal care.

features.title: Expose valid native ladder interactions
features.recommendation: Keep the tagged-tile native-transition adapter. Earthworks owns its excavation/climb affordances and Fences & Gates owns construction content; do not replace either domain state with a generic traversal engine.

features.title: Optional nonblocking recap at session start
features.recommendation: A nonblocking recap fits UI presentation. Domain providers retain data permissions, age/completeness and provenance; Knowledge & Wisdom history is not a live omniscient session report.
